A Lesser Daemon immediately manifests through the rent (see page 349 for two examples: a Bloodletter or a Daemonette). Perform an Opposed Channelling (Dhar)/ Cool Test with the daemon. If successful, the daemon will respond to one command issued by you, quite literally, then vanish (assuming the command is completed before the Duration ends). If failed, the daemon immediately attacks.

name: Octagram
text: CN: 10 Range: Touch Target: AoE (Intelligence Bonus yards across, maximum) Duration: Willpower minutes Daubing an octagram to the floor, and marking it with unholy symbols, you ward against all daemonic influence. Those with the Daemonic Trait cannot enter or leave the octagram.

name: Raise Dead
text: CN: 7 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Until sunrise You channel a heavy flow of Dhar into bare earth, causing old bones to gather and rise. 1 + SL Skeletons (see page 339) claw upwards into the affected area at the end of the Round, which are organised as you prefer within the Area of Effect. They start with the Prone Condition. The summoned undead are entirely under your control and can perform simple orders as you command. If you are killed or gain the Unconscious Condition, the Spell comes to an end and the summoned undead collapse. For each +2 SL, you may summon an extra Skeleton.

name: Reanimate
text: CN: 8 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Until sunrise You channel worming strands of thick Dhar before you, sinking it into corpses, reanimating that which was once dead. Reanimate WPB + SL dead bodies (as Zombies, see page 340) or skeletons (as Skeletons, see page 339) within range. They start with the Prone Condition. The summoned undead are entirely under your control and can perform simple orders as you command. If you die or gain an Unconscious Condition, the Spell comes to an end and the reanimated corpses fall dead again. For each +2 SL, you may reanimate an extra WPB + SL Skeletons or Zombies.

name: Screaming Skull
text: CN: 8 Range: Willpower yards Target: Special Duration: Instant You shriek the high-pitched words of the spell and a large, black skull wreathed with greenish-purple fire forms before you, then flies forwards, screaming and cackling as it goes. The skull moves in a straight line for the Spell range, following the contours of the land, passing through any obstacles in its way. Screaming Skull is a magic missile with Damage +WPB that only affects targets without the Undead Creature Trait. Any suffering Wounds from the Spell must pass a Challenging (+0 SL) Psychology Test or take a Broken Condition.

name: Vanhel’s Call
text: CN: 6 Range: Willpower yards Target: Special Duration: Instant You manipulate complicated flows of Dhar into your targets, filling them with overwhelming energy. Intelligence Bonus targets with the Undead Trait gain a free Move or Action — choose one to affect all targets — taken the moment the Spell is cast. For each +2 SL, you may invigorate an extra Intelligence Bonus targets.

name: Festering Inflammation
text: CN: 5 Range: Willpower Bonus yards Target: 1 Duration: Instant You conjure up septic fluids in the wounds of your opponent. One of the target’s Wounds becomes a Festering Wound.

name: Miasma of Pestilence
text: CN: 6 Range: You Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds A thin mist gathers around you. All living creatures within the Area of Effect must pass a Hard (-2 SL) Endurance Test or suffer from the Nausea Symptom (see page 182). Those dedicated to Nurgle, and skaven plague monks, are not affected.

name: Stream of Corruption
text: CN: 9 Range: Special Target: Special Duration: Instant Your maw distends horrifically before you vomit forth a foul stream of diseased filth and horror. Immediately make an Unopposed Acid- and Poison-type Breath attack (see page 357). It counts as a magic missile with a Damage equal to your Toughness Bonus, and it ignores Armour Points. Further, any targets that take more than their TB in Wounds must pass a Challenging (+0 SL) Endurance Test or contract Blood Rot (see page 179).

name: Acquiescence
text: CN: 5 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds Your magic pierces deep within your target, flooding their senses with strange, euphoric sensations. At the start of each Round, the target must make a Challenging (+0 SL) Endurance Test. If they fail, they lose their Move and Action as they are overwhelmed with blissful sensation.

name: From Pain, Pleasure
text: CN: 6 Range: Touch Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds You confound the target’s senses, transforming pain to pleasure. The target gains the Painless Creature Trait (see page 360) for the duration of the Spell. As they endure injuries, they experience a wave of pleasurable sensation. Should they suffer a Critical Wound, they must pass an Average (+2 SL) Endurance Test or drop their weapons, standing Helplessly as their enemies rain blows down upon them, lost in the ecstatic rending of their own flesh.

name: Phantasmagoria
text: CN: 8 Range: You Target: AoE (Willpower Bonus yards) Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds In response to your invocation, unearthly visions of beguiling and fearsome creatures fill the area of effect, giving you and all allies the Distracting Creature Trait (see page 358) for the duration of the Spell. Targets do not distract one another.

name: Boon of Tzeentch
text: CN: 9 Range: You Target: You Duration: Intelligence Bonus days The Changer of the Ways twists your mind, granting you access to arcane knowledge. Choose one Spell from any Lore. For the Duration, you may cast it as if you had memorised it, but may not record it in a grimoire. If you channel to cast the new Spell, you may use either Channelling (Dhar) or the Channelling Skill appropriate to the Spell, should you possess it. If you suffer a Miscast when casting this new Spell, Boon of Tzeentch quits your mind in disgust, and also erases itself from your grimoire should it have allowed itself to be recorded there.

name: Transformation of Tzeentch
text: CN: 12 Range: Willpower Bonus yards Target: 1 Duration: Willpower Bonus Rounds At your command, bonds of aethyric fire coil from the earth, shrouding your target in a cocoon of magical energy. The target gains the Prone Condition and is considered Helpless for the duration. At the end of each Round, they must pass a Challenging (+0 SL) Endurance Test or gain 1 Corruption Point.

name: Treason of Tzeentch
text: CN: 6 Range: Willpower yards Target: AoE (Initiative Bonus yards) Duration: Intelligence Bonus Rounds You channel fine strands of traitorous thoughts into your targets’ minds, twisting their motivations and fanning fires of discontent. Targets gain Animosity (Allies). Further, unless immune to that Psychology, they cannot transfer Advantage to their allies and, if they score a Critical when attacking, they must pass a Hard (-2 SL) Cool Test or target their nearest ally.
